newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Tuesday that around 1,200 head were exported into the United States at two crossing points Monday.
Through Nogales, Ariz., around 1,000 head were sold at prices that were firm to 1 cent/lb higher. "Trade active, demand good," USDA said.
Prices were 88-98 cents/lb for head weighing 300-400 lb and for 400-500 ln head they were 80-88 cents/lb.
Through Del Rio, Texas, around 200 head were sold, although not enough to establish trend prices.
((--Chris Aspin, Mexico City newsroom (525) 7289530. E-mail at chris.aspin@reuters.com))
